subject: Next steps & accelerated PoC schedule for Novanet
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@novanet.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: PoC success criteria & proposed accelerated schedule

Thanks again for your time today, Priya — really productive call. Per our discussion, I captured the high-level success criteria and a tight 4-week timeline to validate integration and latency/cost economics so Novanet can decide by end of January.

High-level success criteria (from today):
- API throughput: sustain 80 qps with 95th pct latency < 250ms for 128-token responses
- Accuracy: intent-classification F1 >= 0.88 on the shared test prompts
- Cost: avg token cost within the target envelope we discussed (estimate in MAP)
- Security: VPC peering + audit logs enabled and sample SOC 2 artifacts provided

Proposed fastpath timeline (draft):
Week 0 (this week) — Kickoff: env access, data handoff, initial eval prompts loaded
Week 1 — Integration sprint: connector + routing tests, baseline perf runs
Week 2 — Eval sprint: run full prompt suite, tune batching and cache; begin security checklist
Week 3 — Readout prep: consolidated metrics, cost analysis, and blocker list
Week 4 — Final readout + acceptance decision

Owners (initial):
- Redwood technical lead / integration: Aditya Rao (aditya.rao@redwood.com)
- Success lead / ops cadence: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com)
- Customer PM / contact: Priya Gupta (priya.gupta@novanet.com)

I attached a quick MAP (mutual action plan) and the sample prompt set we discussed. Please confirm: 1) kickoff slot on Monday 2026-12-21 at 10:00 PT works for your team, and 2) whether Arjun will be the primary infra owner for the VPC peering.

Next steps I can drive once you confirm: lock kickoff invite, provision sandbox creds, and circulate the weekly check-in cadence (30m Tuesdays).

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Attachments: Novanet_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), novanet_sample_prompts.csv (csv), redwood_poc_sow_draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@novanet.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@novanet.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T18:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: PoC success criteria & proposed accelerated schedule

Thanks, Naomi — the recap looks spot on and tight is good (we need velocity on this). Monday 12/21 10:00 PT works for me and Arjun. We'll confirm an internal attendee list by EOD Friday.

Couple quick clarifications:
- For accuracy, can we add a small holdout set (20%) that we don't look at until the readout? We want to avoid overfitting during the eval sprint.
- On the VPC peering, Arjun will own it but we may need a short notice window for our security team to sign an inbound rule change — likely Tue morning.

I'll loop in our legal contact if we need a quick SOW redline; otherwise we'll treat your draft as the starting point. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Priya
Priya Gupta
Head of AI Product, Novanet
priya.gupta@novanet.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@novanet.com>, Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@novanet.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: PoC success criteria & proposed accelerated schedule

Great, thanks for confirming. A few operational notes from my side before we kick off:
- I'll need the sample data schema and a short list of the 5 highest-priority prompt templates by EOD Monday so we can pre-provision the evaluation runners and avoid a dry run on day 1.
- For the 80 qps target — can we align on expected payload sizes? My baseline assumes ~110 tokens/request; if your typical payloads are larger we should adjust the perf target or split tests by payload bucket.
- I'll prepare two config profiles for the trial: "balanced" (moderate batching + 8-bit quant) and "low-latency" (reduced batching, single-token stream). We'll include cost estimates for both in the week-3 readout.

I'll take the lead on the integration checklist and own the first three infra tasks in the MAP. Marissa — can you own running the weekly readout doc and capturing acceptance votes?

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@novanet.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: PoC logistics + kickoff confirmed 12/21 10:00 PT

Thanks all — kickoff is locked for Monday 12/21 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Quick confirmations and owners: 
- Priya: holdout set agreed (we'll keep 20% sealed until week-4 readout) — noted.
- Arjun: security gating window Tue AM acknowledged; we'll schedule the peering test for Tue 9:00 PT.
- Aditya: please post the pre-kickoff checklist (data schema + top 5 prompts) in the HubSpot deal thread and Drive folder by Monday 9:00 PT.
- Marissa: I'll ask you to run the Week 1 and Week 2 readouts; please use the attached POc readout template and default to Tue 30m cadence starting 12/29.

Risk callouts: if the VPC peering slips more than 48 hours we will fall back to a hosted sandbox (no peering) with a slightly higher cost profile — we'll surface the impact in the day-2 perf runs.

Thanks — I'll share meeting notes and the meeting recording after kickoff.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: Novanet_MAP_v3.xlsx, redwood_poc_sow_draft.pdf
